data.name: ShortcutTipFormat
data.comment: A tooltip with the shortcut: {0} the control's name ("New project"), {1} its shortcut ("Ctrl+N").

data.name: ChooseFolderShortcut
data.comment: Choose folder's shortcut in a tooltip and beside the Add photos menu item. The letter is fixed in code; translate only "Ctrl", as Windows names that key in the language.

data.name: ChooseFolderKeys
data.comment: Choose folder's shortcut as a screen reader names it (its accelerator key). Translate only "Control".

data.name: ChoosePhotosShortcut
data.comment: Choose photos' shortcut in a tooltip and beside the Add photos menu item. Translate only "Ctrl" and "Shift".

data.name: ChoosePhotosKeys
data.comment: Choose photos' shortcut as a screen reader names it (its accelerator key). Translate only "Control" and "Shift".

data.name: NewProjectShortcut
data.comment: New project's shortcut in its tooltip. Translate only "Ctrl".

data.name: NewProjectKeys
data.comment: New project's shortcut as a screen reader names it (its accelerator key). Translate only "Control".

data.name: ExportShortcut
data.comment: Export video's shortcut in its tooltip. Translate only "Ctrl".

data.name: PlayShortcut
data.comment: The play button's key in its tooltip: the name Windows gives the space bar in the language.

data.name: PlayKeys
data.comment: The play button's key as a screen reader names it (its accelerator key).

data.name: BackKeys
data.comment: Settings' Back button's key as a screen reader names it (its accelerator key; Alt+Left and the mouse's back button work too).
